subject: I got huge chromosomes of more than 1000 cM with read.cross function

messages.author: e414e28cd4417c50
messages.subject: I got huge chromosomes of more than 1000 cM with read.cross function
parts:
Hello. 
I'm working in a qtl analysis from a GBS.When I tried to read data I used:

> data.F2.LxH <- read.cross("csv", file="C:/Users/ED2.csv",  sep=";",
                          genotypes=c("A","H","B"), alleles=c("A","B"))

It's result is:

 --Read the following data:
25  individuals
140  markers
3  phenotypes
 --Cross type: f2 
Warning messages:
1: In summary.cross(cross) :
  Some markers at the same position on chr 2; use jittermap().
2: In summary.cross(cross) :
  Some chromosomes > 1000 cM in length; there may be a problem with the genetic map.
  (Perhaps it is in basepairs?)

I can fix the markers that are in the same position, but I don't know why I've got huge chromosomes of more than 1000 cM. How can I fix this problem?

Thanks

messages.author: 96353e7106735838
messages.subject: Re: [Rqtl-disc] I got huge chromosomes of more than 1000 cM with read.cross function
parts:
There are a variety of possible cause. Most commonly, positions were provided in basepairs. R/qtl wants a genetic map with positions in cM. Positions in Mbp would be better than bp.

karl
